headline: ARC Prize says Argon used fewer actions than human baseline

sections.text: ARC Prize says Argon used fewer actions than the human baseline across the 25 public games, matched or beat three speedrun records and came close to six others. The comparison concerns the public-game tests; the live ARC-AGI-3 leaderboard separately ranks Kaggle entries and remains provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
